title: 3 第3章 剑型吊坠4 第4章 夜袭
content_zh:
暴走中的碧眼大蛇，将所有人都掀飞。
林轩根本没有多少灵力，身上多处都受到重创。
好在他提前吞下了火灵芝，那雄厚的药力正化解着他的伤势，可尽管如此，他还是大口的吐血。
他的身子掉到了山沟中，这一下摔得他浑身的骨头都快断了，胸前的衣襟早就染成了红色，林轩没有注意到，他的血液沾到那剑型吊坠上，全都诡异的消失了。
轰！
又是一击蛇尾，林轩再次被抽飞，这一次他直接昏了过去，那龙形吊坠完全没入他的体内，化成一道光芒，一闪消失了。
那剑型吊坠钻入他的丹田之中，不断地颤动，四周的灵力快速的向着林轩涌去，他的腹部形成的一个小黑洞，将涌来的灵力全部吸进。
有些灵力钻入林轩体内，四处流窜，不断地撞击这林轩的经脉。
要知道，林轩体内的灵脉并没有打通，所以当这些遗漏下来的灵力进入时，那疼痛比自己打通灵脉要疼十倍。
林轩从昏迷中被痛醒了，他咬着牙忍受着，并不知道发生了什么事情。
而当他发现罪魁祸首时，他差点疯掉，体内的小剑是他的吊坠，并且现在正在疯狂的吞噬灵力。
虽然大部分的灵力都被这小剑吞噬了，可是溢出的那一小部分也不是林轩所能消化的了得。
“靠，这已经到炼体九阶了，再这样下去就是冲脉了！”
人体内有九大灵脉，它们贯通人体，只有打通灵脉，灵力才能在体内循环，产生力量。
林轩的修为如同坐火箭一样，飞速上升，很快就到了炼体巅峰，他一咬牙，准备借着这股力量冲击灵脉。
他强忍着疼痛，努力的击中精神，准备冲击体内的第一道灵脉。
双手捏成印记，林轩全力冲击，那体内的灵力汇聚在一起，向着那第一灵脉冲去。
轰！
仿佛一道无形的墙壁挡在面前，那些灵力被冲散，林轩的修为快速的下降，最后又掉到了灵徒三阶。
“又是这样！”

林轩不不甘的吼道，他已经冲击过两次了，每次都被弹了回来，他的体内仿佛有一道神秘的力量，将他牢牢的封锁住。
“再来！”
林轩不信邪，再次将体内的灵力汇聚到一起，向着灵脉冲去。
轰隆隆——
两股力量相撞，在林轩的体内发出轰鸣之声，他受到冲击，再次大口吐血。
这是，体内出现了一股柔和的力量，林轩知道那是火灵芝的药力，好在提前吞服了它，不然现在恐怕早就死了。
这些灵力在林轩体内越积越多，他的身体感到无比的胀痛。
“你大爷的，你还吸，赶紧停下了！”
林轩现在能清晰的看到体内的一切，他急的大骂，但是那小剑一点反应都没有。
现在的灵力这么多，应该能够冲破那道封锁。
林轩决定在冲击一次，不过这次失败了，他的下场就是被灵力撑爆。
“拼了，就算有一丝希望，我也要试一下！”
林轩就是这样的人，不到最后一刻，决不放弃。
这次，无尽的灵力化成一股怒流，朝着那未被开辟的灵脉而去。
content_en:
The rampaging blue-eyed snake knocked everyone away.
Lin Xuan didn't have much spiritual power at all, and suffered heavy injuries in many places on his body.
Fortunately, he had swallowed Fire Ganoderma in advance, and the strong medicinal power was resolving his injuries, but despite this, he was still vomiting blood.
His body fell into the ravine, and all the bones in his body were almost broken by the fall. The clothes on his chest had long been dyed red. Lin Xuan didn't notice that his blood was on the sword-shaped pendant, and all of it disappeared strangely.
boom!
With another blow to the snake's tail, Lin Xuan was whipped away again. This time he passed out directly. The dragon-shaped pendant was completely submerged in his body, turned into a ray of light, and disappeared in a flash.
The sword-shaped pendant penetrated into his Dantian and trembled continuously. The spiritual energy around him quickly surged towards Lin Xuan. A small black hole formed in his abdomen sucked in all the incoming spiritual energy.
Some spiritual power penetrated into Lin Xuan's body and flowed around, constantly hitting Lin Xuan's meridians.
You must know that the spiritual veins in Lin Xuan's body have not been opened, so when the missing spiritual power enters, the pain is ten times more painful than opening the spiritual veins on his own.
Lin Xuan was awakened from the coma by the pain. He gritted his teeth and endured it, not knowing what happened.
And when he discovered the culprit, he almost went crazy. The small sword in his body was his pendant, and it was now devouring spiritual power crazily.
Although most of the spiritual power was swallowed up by the small sword, the small part that overflowed was not something Lin Xuan could digest.
"Damn, this is already the ninth level of body refining. If it continues like this, it will be a pulse attack!"
There are nine spiritual meridians in the human body, which run through the human body. Only by opening the spiritual meridians can spiritual energy circulate in the body and generate power.
Lin Xuan's cultivation level rose rapidly like a rocket, and he soon reached the peak of body refining. He gritted his teeth and prepared to use this power to attack his spiritual veins.
He endured the pain and worked hard to hit his spirit, preparing to hit the first spiritual vein in his body.
Making a mark with his hands, Lin Xuan attacked with all his strength. The spiritual power in his body gathered together and headed towards the first spiritual pulse.
boom!
As if an invisible wall stood in front of him, the spiritual power was washed away. Lin Xuan's cultivation level dropped rapidly, and finally he fell to the third level of spiritual disciple.
"That's it again!"
Lin Xuan shouted unwillingly. He had been hit twice, and was bounced back every time. There seemed to be a mysterious force in his body, sealing him firmly.
"Come again!"
Lin Xuan did not believe in evil, and once again gathered the spiritual power in his body together and directed towards the spiritual pulse.
Rumble——
The two forces collided, making a roaring sound in Lin Xuan's body. He was shocked and vomited blood again.
At this time, a gentle force appeared in the body. Lin Xuan knew that it was the medicinal power of Fire Ganoderma. Fortunately, he had swallowed it in advance, otherwise he would have died by now.
These spiritual powers accumulated more and more in Lin Xuan's body, and his body felt extremely painful.
"Your uncle, you're still sucking, stop it now!"
Lin Xuan could clearly see everything inside his body now. He cursed anxiously, but the little sword didn't react at all.
With so much spiritual energy now, he should be able to break through that blockade.
Lin Xuan decided to attack again, but this time he failed, and his end was that he was exploded by spiritual power.
"Fight, even if there is a glimmer of hope, I will give it a try!"
Lin Xuan is such a person, he will never give up until the last moment.
This time, the endless spiritual power turned into a furious current, heading towards the unopened spiritual veins.
